meta.band_caveat: ILLUSTRATIVE RANGE, NOT A VALIDATED 90% INTERVAL. The per-site band is conformal-calibrated at DKASC (Australia) and its site coverage is measured. The national aggregation is not validated: it uses a shrinkage factor that assumes equal regional error scales and one common correlation, neither of which holds for population-weighted regions of unequal capacity; it treats conformal half-widths as if they were standard deviations; and the correlation is estimated from forecast CLEAR-SKY INDEX as a proxy for forecast-ERROR correlation, which measurement showed can differ substantially. No measured Tunisian national series was available to score it against.
